body:
LICENSING/ASSET LEAD: A citation or image-search `license` filter is not permission. Default-deny any public card asset lacking a machine-enforced RightsRecord: `{asset_hash, canonical_source_url, creator, title, rights_holder, license_id+version+URL/custom grant, retrieved_at, use_scope, commercial_ok, adaptations_ok, attribution_text, territory/expiry, person/trademark release, evidence_hash}`. State machine: `quarantined -> rights_verified -> normalized -> publishable -> published`; only rights service/reviewer advances it, never LLM/search. Publish atomically checks approved bytes hash, presentation commercial/context flags, license still valid, transformation compatibility, attribution present and no takedown/embargo. Unknown/all-rights-reserved/ambiguous => private link candidate only, no audience image/excerpt.

MVP allow policy: public domain/CC0; CC BY with TASL attribution + change notice; CC BY-SA only if the product can actually satisfy share-alike; CC ND only unchanged (safest: no crop/overlay/color/AI edit, only aspect-preserving technical resize); CC NC only for deployments affirmatively classified noncommercial and reviewed. Custom stock/organizational grants are explicit policy records. Creator/source/license attribution is rendered on-card plus full credits export; naming a hosting site is not author attribution. Licenses do not automatically clear privacy/publicity, moral, trademark or third-party rights, so identifiable people/brands require separate release/review. User-uploaded PPT/PDF attestation does not license extracted assets for reuse in new cards.

Do not hotlink. Backend fetches approved HTTPS canonical URL through SSRF-isolated egress: domain allowlist where possible; resolve and reject loopback/private/link-local/metadata IP before request and after every redirect; limit redirects/bytes/time/pixels; verify magic/MIME; reject SVG for MVP; decode + safe raster re-encode/malware scan. Strip GPS/device EXIF but preserve C2PA provenance or emit a derivative manifest linked to original. C2PA proves provenance/integrity, NOT copyright permission. Serve immutable hash-addressed bytes from own CDN with Audience CSP `img-src 'self' <own-cdn>` and `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, preventing beacons/content swaps.

For text sources, prefer a title + canonical link + original paraphrase; direct excerpts need an encoded license/grant or counsel-approved exception. `robots.txt`, discoverability, citation and fair-use assertion are not licenses; courts ultimately decide fair use. Generated images need provider/model/terms-version/prompt-input provenance, `ai_generated` label and rights/person/brand review—provider output terms are not a non-infringement warranty.

Every asset hash indexes all live cards for one-click takedown/unpublish. Preserve rights evidence and audit, not the removed bytes. Tests: unknown license denied; NC denied in commercial mode; modified ND denied; missing attribution denied; URL bytes changed denied; redirect-to-private-IP denied; revoked asset disappears from all audience clients.

Sources: https://www.wipo.int/copyright/en/ ; https://www.copyright.gov/help/faq/faq-fairuse.html ; https://creativecommons.org/about/cclicenses/ ; https://wiki.creativecommons.org/wiki/Recommended_practices_for_attribution ; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.en ; https://rightsstatements.org/page/1.0/?language=en ; https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Server_Side_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html ; https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/File_Upload_Cheat_Sheet.html ; https://c2pa.org/specifications/specifications/2.2/specs/C2PA_Specification.html
